purpose: Six fixed, non-overlapping 63-question CCAR-P practice papers (Practice exam 1-6), plus the existing random mix.

pool.note: Every pool item appears in exactly one paper. Existing-bank items are reused under a PX- prefix with wording overrides in ccar-p.papers-overrides.js; the source bank is unchanged.

constraints: Every paper matches the exam's seven-domain weights and the 44/14/5 item-type mix of the existing exam simulation.
Every paper covers all 38 exam-guide objectives and never repeats a concept family.
Correct-answer positions are balanced (20-30% per position across all single-answer items, at most 40% within one paper).
The correct choice is the longest in at most 40% of single-answer items; both correct choices are the two longest in at most 40% of multiple-response items.
Question stems within a paper have word overlap (Jaccard) below 0.6.
contentProvenance: Original practice content written for this repository. No live, recalled or third-party exam content. Every item has liveExamContent set to false.

formatReference.description: A user-supplied list of commercial CCAR-P mock-exam products was consulted for format facts only: 63 questions, 120 minutes, single-answer and multiple-response items, and sets of six full-length papers.

followUps: The practice-question bank outside these papers still often makes the correct choice the longest one. The papers correct this through overrides; the practice bank itself needs the same review.
Updated CCAR-P exam guides are due November 17, 2026, with content effective December 7, 2026. Re-verify objectives and weights against the new guide and rebuild the layout.
